sn11.19:1.2: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave sakko devānamindo mātaliṃ saṅgāhakaṃ āmantesi
sn11.19:1.3: yojehi samma mātali sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyāti.
sn11.19:1.4: evaṃ bhaddantavāti kho bhikkhave mātali saṅgāhako sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā sakkassa devānamindassa paṭivedesi
sn11.19:1.5: yutto kho te mārisa sahassayutto ājaññaratho
sn11.19:1.7: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo vejayantapāsādā orohanto añjaliṃ katvā sudaṃ bhagavantaṃ namassati.
sn11.19:1.8: atha kho bhikkhave mātali saṅgāhako sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
